ui-ux-quality.title: UI/UX Quality 改进
ui-ux-quality.description: Fix state ownership drift, composition correctness, and UX gaps across the ui/ module. Based on double-design review (Claude + Codex, 2026-04-08) and re-review (2026-04-15). Central thesis: state ownership drift is the primary quality problem — fix correctness before polish.
acceptCriteria: All child tasks done
./gradlew assembleDebug passes
./gradlew test passes

uiux-capsule-compose.title: Phase 1: Capsule Composition Correctness
uiux-capsule-compose.description:
SmartCapsuleSurface.kt violates Compose's side-effect-free render model in two ways: (1) `previousModeState.value = mode` is written inside `remember(...)` block at line 71, making behavior depend on recomposition order, (2) `inputText = ""` is written during composition at line 80 when `clearInput` is true. This is amplified because the surface is shared by both in-app and overlay rendering paths.

Additionally, SmartCapsuleCompose.kt (the in-app wrapper) does not pass `previousMode` at all (line 41-56), relying entirely on the internal fallback that depends on the composition-time write.

Approach:
- Remove `previousModeState` from SmartCapsuleSurface — callers provide previous mode
- Add `previousMode` parameter plumbing through SmartCapsuleCompose.kt (the in-app caller must track and pass it, matching what CapsuleOverlayHost already does)
- Replace composition-time `inputText = ""` with a `LaunchedEffect` keyed on mode transition (or renderSpec.row3?.clearInput)
- Keep CapsuleRenderSpec.from() pure — no state writes inside remember
acceptCriteria: grep -n 'previousModeState' SmartCapsuleSurface.kt returns no results (internal tracking removed)
SmartCapsuleCompose.kt passes previousMode parameter to SmartCapsuleSurface
No state writes inside remember {} blocks in SmartCapsuleSurface.kt (grep -n 'previousModeState.value =' returns empty)
inputText clearing happens inside LaunchedEffect or DisposableEffect, not during composition body
CapsuleRenderSpec.from() is a pure function with no side effects
./gradlew assembleDebug passes
./gradlew test passes

uiux-settings-state.title: Phase 2: Settings State Hoisting + rememberSaveable
uiux-settings-state.description:
Settings state drifts from real app state in three ways: (1) SettingsSheet.kt:70 keeps page selection in local `remember` that resets on config change, (2) LlmAuthSettingsPage.kt:72-79 initializes `selectedTab` once from external authMethod/llmBackend and never updates when those change externally, (3) LlmAuthSettingsPage.kt:88-112 tab taps immediately fire `onBackendChange`/`onAuthMethodChange` — exploring tabs mutates committed backend/auth state. Same pattern at lines 225-250 for API-key provider selection.

Additionally, zero `rememberSaveable` usage exists across the entire ui/ module — rotation or activity recreation resets all user-visible local state.

Approach:
- Replace `remember` with `rememberSaveable` for settingsPage, selectedTab, selectedProvider
- Make selectedTab/selectedProvider reactive to external state changes (use derivedStateOf or re-key on external inputs)
- Separate UI-only tab exploration from committed mutations: tab taps update local selection only; actual backend/auth changes happen on explicit user action (e.g., 'Apply' or selecting a model within the tab)
- Same decoupling for API-key provider selection
acceptCriteria: grep -rn 'rememberSaveable' SettingsSheet.kt LlmAuthSettingsPage.kt returns at least one match per file
Reopening settings after external model/auth change shows the correct tab and provider (not stale cached value)
Tapping a tab does NOT immediately call onBackendChange or onAuthMethodChange (grep confirms no direct call inside tab onClick)
Screen rotation on a nested settings page preserves the current page/tab/provider selection
./gradlew assembleDebug passes
./gradlew test passes

uiux-chat-scroll.title: Phase 3: Chat Scroll + Cleanup
uiux-chat-scroll.description:
Chat auto-scroll is broken for streaming: LaunchedEffect(messages.size) at ChatScreen.kt:191-196 only fires when the message count changes. Streaming text updates and action-card additions mutate the last message in place (ChatEventReducer.kt:68-71, :95-98) without changing list size, so content grows below the fold without the viewport following. Conversely, any new message snaps to bottom even if the user is reading history.

Two additional chat cleanup items:
- MessageBubble.kt:188-190 allocates a new SimpleDateFormat per recomposition (not thread-safe, GC pressure during streaming). TimeUtils.kt already has a thread-safe DateTimeFormatter pattern.
- ActionCard.kt:171-184 wraps CircularProgressIndicator (which already animates internally) in an extra infiniteTransition rotation, creating double animation.

Approach:
- Implement 'stick to bottom' policy: track whether user is near bottom of list before auto-scrolling
- Trigger scroll on last-message content growth (not just message count change) when user is following
- Show a 'scroll to bottom' FAB when user has scrolled up and new content arrives
- Replace SimpleDateFormat with top-level DateTimeFormatter val
- Remove infiniteTransition rotation wrapper; use plain indeterminate CircularProgressIndicator
acceptCriteria: ChatScreen no longer uses LaunchedEffect(messages.size) as sole scroll trigger (grep confirms removal or replacement)
Scroll behavior tracks user position: auto-scroll only when user is near bottom
A 'scroll to bottom' FAB or equivalent appears when user scrolls up during active streaming
grep -n 'SimpleDateFormat' MessageBubble.kt returns no results (replaced with DateTimeFormatter)
grep -n 'infiniteTransition' ActionCard.kt returns no results (redundant rotation removed)
./gradlew assembleDebug passes
./gradlew test passes

uiux-destructive-confirm.title: Phase 4: Destructive Action Confirmation Dialogs
uiux-destructive-confirm.description:
Three destructive actions execute immediately with no confirmation:
1. Session delete in NavigationDrawer.kt:274-283 — IconButton calls onDelete directly, 32dp touch target increases accidental tap risk
2. 'Clear Traces' in PermissionsAdvancedSettingsPage.kt (~line 208-215) — executes immediately
3. 'Clear Session History' in PermissionsAdvancedSettingsPage.kt (~line 216-227) — executes immediately

All three are irreversible data-loss actions that should require explicit user confirmation.

Approach:
- Add a `showDeleteConfirm` state + AlertDialog pattern to each action
- Dialog text: describe what will be lost, with [Cancel] and [Delete/Clear] buttons
- ~15 lines per dialog, no structural changes needed
acceptCriteria: grep -n 'AlertDialog' NavigationDrawer.kt returns at least one match (confirmation dialog exists)
grep -n 'AlertDialog' PermissionsAdvancedSettingsPage.kt returns at least two matches (one per destructive action)
Session delete requires two taps: delete button → confirm dialog → confirm button
Clear Traces requires two taps: button → confirm dialog → confirm button
Clear Session History requires two taps: button → confirm dialog → confirm button
./gradlew assembleDebug passes

uiux-a11y-fixes.title: Phase 5: 3 Targeted Accessibility Fixes
uiux-a11y-fixes.description:
Three specific accessibility gaps remain (chat header and drawer already fixed):

1. OnboardingShell.kt:54-61 — back button uses Icon + Modifier.clickable at 24dp instead of IconButton. Missing the standard 48dp minimum touch target. Screen readers see a clickable image with no button role.

2. StatusIslandCompose.kt:30-43 — clickable Surface with no explicit role or action label, only defaultMinSize(minHeight=32.dp). Also uses hardcoded Color.White and Color(0xFF171717) instead of theme tokens. Fix both a11y and theming together.

3. SmartCapsuleSurfaceParts.kt:255-266 — NavIconButton has contentDescription = null for icon-only capsule navigation actions (minimize, open app, open viewer).

Approach:
- Replace Icon+clickable with IconButton in OnboardingShell
- Add semantics { role = Role.Button } + contentDescription to StatusIslandCompose Surface; replace hardcoded colors with MaterialTheme tokens
- Add meaningful contentDescription strings to NavIconButton calls (derive from NavAction: 'Minimize', 'Open app', 'Open viewer')
acceptCriteria: grep -n 'IconButton' OnboardingShell.kt returns at least one match (back button uses IconButton)
grep -n 'Modifier.clickable' OnboardingShell.kt returns no matches for the back button area
grep -n 'contentDescription = null' SmartCapsuleSurfaceParts.kt returns no matches in NavIconButton calls
grep -n 'Color.White\|0xFF171717' StatusIslandCompose.kt returns no matches (hardcoded colors replaced with theme tokens)
grep -n 'Role.Button\|contentDescription' StatusIslandCompose.kt returns at least one match
./gradlew assembleDebug passes

uiux-overlay-state.title: Phase 6: Narrow Overlay State Unification
uiux-overlay-state.description:
CapsuleOverlayHost.kt:73-76 still keeps its own `capsuleContext`, `platformMode`, and `hasIsland` MutableStateFlow instances that duplicate canonical state from CapsuleStateHolder. CapsuleOverlayHost.kt:213-221 exposes `updateNavContext()` to mutate these local flows. ServiceOverlayController.kt:376-383 writes the same render inputs into both stateHolder and capsuleManager, duplicating the mutation path.

CapsuleStateHolder already centralizes mode, context, platformMode, and turnPhase. IslandOverlayHost already reads from stateHolder. The gap is only in CapsuleOverlayHost.

Host-only concerns (focusability, touchability, interaction locks, inputFocused) are correctly host-owned and must stay.

Approach:
- Remove duplicate `capsuleContext`, `platformMode`, `hasIsland` flows from CapsuleOverlayHost
- CapsuleOverlayHost reads these values from CapsuleStateHolder instead
- Remove `updateNavContext()` — callers use CapsuleStateHolder.setContext() etc.
- Update ServiceOverlayController to write render state only to stateHolder, not both
- Keep host-only state (focusability, touchability, interactionLocked, inputFocused) in CapsuleOverlayHost
acceptCriteria: grep -n 'private val capsuleContext' CapsuleOverlayHost.kt returns no results (duplicate flow removed)
grep -n 'private val platformMode' CapsuleOverlayHost.kt returns no results (duplicate flow removed)
grep -n 'private val hasIsland' CapsuleOverlayHost.kt returns no results (duplicate flow removed)
grep -n 'updateNavContext' CapsuleOverlayHost.kt returns no results (method removed)
CapsuleOverlayHost reads context/platformMode/hasIsland from stateHolder flows
ServiceOverlayController writes render state to stateHolder only, not both stateHolder and capsuleManager
./gradlew assembleDebug passes
./gradlew test passes

uiux-codex-review.title: Codex Code Review + Fix Round
uiux-codex-review.description: Send all UI/UX quality changes to Codex for systematic code review. Codex reviews the diff of all uiux-* task changes against the aligned design (doc/todo/holistic-review/ui-ux-quality/final/improvement_plan.md). Covers: (1) capsule composition correctness — verify no state writes during composition, previousMode plumbing correct, (2) settings state hoisting — rememberSaveable usage, tab/provider mutation decoupling, (3) chat scroll — bottom-stickiness policy, SimpleDateFormat removal, double rotation removal, (4) destructive action confirmation dialogs, (5) a11y fixes — IconButton, contentDescription, theme tokens, (6) overlay state unification — duplicate flows removed. Fix any critical/high findings before proceeding to QA. Use /code-review skill via multmux.

uiux-qa-real-device.title: QA Round: Real Device Validation
uiux-qa-real-device.description:
Run end-to-end QA on real device to validate UI/UX changes do not regress user-facing behavior. Test scenarios:

1. Capsule transitions: overlay capsule Hidden→WaitingForInput→Running→Done cycle — input clears exactly once on transition, no repeated focus/input glitches, in-app and overlay paths behave identically
2. Settings state: open settings, switch tabs (OAuth/API Key/Local), rotate device — tab/provider preserved; change model externally via intent, reopen settings — correct tab shown; explore tabs without committing — backend/auth state unchanged
3. Chat streaming: send a task that produces a long streaming response — viewport follows content growth; scroll up mid-stream — not yanked back, scroll-to-bottom affordance appears; new message after scrolling up — affordance visible
4. Destructive actions: tap session delete — confirmation dialog appears, cancel works, confirm deletes; same for Clear Traces and Clear Session History in settings
5. Accessibility: TalkBack pass on onboarding back button, capsule nav buttons, status island — all announced with correct labels and roles
6. Normal multi-turn task: complete a real task end-to-end without regression

Use /ux-visual-debug or adb-driven interaction.
acceptCriteria: QA report exists at projects/archive/20260417_holistic-review/ui-ux-quality/final/qa_report.md with pass/fail per scenario
Capsule transitions: no focus/input glitches, input clears once, in-app and overlay identical
Settings state: rotation preserves page/tab/provider, external change reflected on reopen, tab exploration does not mutate backend
Chat streaming: viewport follows when at bottom, does not yank when scrolled up, scroll-to-bottom affordance appears
Destructive actions: all 3 actions require confirmation dialog before executing
Accessibility: TalkBack announces correct labels for onboarding back, capsule nav, status island
Normal multi-turn task completes without regression
No ANR or crash in logcat during QA run
